EditorMetadata.Description: Slice 1 proof: blueprint-authored rebuild of the C# oracle Condition_HasTarget (HillAttackTankNodes.cs ~line 113) -- an AiPrimitive BTreeCondition. Graph: EventEntry -> GetParameter(TargetNetworkId) -> FunctionCall HillAssault2TankOps.HasTarget(targetNetworkId, self, view) [P7: self/view auto-appended, hidden from pins] -> Branch -> Return(Success)/Return(Failure). DEVIATION 1 (CLOSED, GAP-11): TargetNetworkId is now declared under Parameters, as the task's design originally called for, and is read natively via a GetParameterNode (Stage5_Schedule.FindParameterIndex resolves a PARAMS-ONLY index; the node lowers to the pre-existing IrOp_ReadParam, which StatementEmitter already emitted as `p.{ParamFieldName}` but which no node previously produced). Formerly, TargetNetworkId had to be mis-declared under WorkingState and read via GetVariable, because GetVariable-node pin/IR resolution (Stage0_Rehydrate.ResolveVariableTypeId, Stage5_Schedule.FindVariableIndex/EmissionContext.VarFieldName) only ever consulted asset.Variables/asset.WorkingState, never asset.Parameters -- there was no node/wiring path that read an AiPrimitive Parameter into a graph at all. GetParameterNode (this fix) closes that gap; WorkingState is now empty and Parameters is exercised for real. FORMER DEVIATION 2 (P7.1 FIX, see GAP-9): this asset previously had to live under Recipes/Blueprints/ (not wired into the real Hrot.AI.Behaviors AdditionalFiles/Roslyn-incremental-generator build) because Stage0_Rehydrate.ResolveMethod / Stage5_Schedule.ResolveClrMethodForContext resolve a FunctionCall's target method via runtime System.Reflection INSIDE the Roslyn incremental-generator's own netstandard2.0 analyzer process, which never has Hrot.AI.Behaviors.dll (or any other game assembly) loaded -- silently dropping self/view and producing CS7036. P7.1 fixes this by baking the trailing-context decision into this node's JSON at author time (see the FunctionCall node's "TrailingContext": "SelfAndView" field and its populated "Pins" array, which already excludes self/view) so Stage5_Schedule honors the baked flag directly with NO reflection at generation time. This asset now lives under Assets/Blueprints/ and compiles through the REAL MSBuild/dotnet-build generator path -- see HillAssault2_HasTarget_ProofTests.cs, which now reflects the real generated Hrot.AI.Behaviors.Generated.HillAssault2HasTarget_*_Bp type out of the built Hrot.AI.Behaviors.dll (mirroring HillAssault2_AbortEngagement_ProofTests) instead of the in-process BlueprintCompiler.Compile workaround. Does not modify the C# oracle.
